title: stenocactus multicostatus subsp. zacatecasensis
intro: Stenocactus multicostatus subsp. zacatecasensis, commonly known as the Zacatecas stenocactus, is a rare and endangered species of cactus native to Mexico. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Stenocactus multicostatus subsp. zacatecasensis include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. Research has identified bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and alkaloids, which are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties.
